title: Enforce origin-signature verification on POST /sos (silent drop)
description: Decomposed from project-LICHEN-worker6-a6qg gap 1. Spec 12-apps.md 18.4.1: SOS MUST carry a valid link-layer origin signature; unsigned/invalid are silently dropped. verify_sos_origin()/SosOriginSignature (lichen.coap.sos_origin) exist with zero production callers; SosResource.render_post accepts unsigned {node,ts} bodies with 2.01. The xfail(strict) pin lives in python/tests/coap/test_security_app_vector_consumers.py::test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped (asserts unsuccessful response). DESIGN DECISION NEEDED (owner): the signed POST wire format — spec 18.4.3's local-POST example body has no signature fields; proposal: body gains 'pubkey' (32B bstr) + 'origin_sig' (56B bstr = seq||sig per SosOriginSignature.to_bytes), verify via verify_sos_origin(pub, fe80::IID(pub), canonicalize_sos_payload(body-minus-sig-fields), sig); missing/invalid -> reject without activating or recording rate-limit state. Enforcement ripples: ~10 green tests across test_security_app_vector_consumers.py and test_sos_resource.py POST unsigned bodies and expect 2.01/4.29 — they must switch to signed bodies with derived keypairs (fixed hex IIDs like 0011223344556677 do not correspond to any keypair). Also check relay path wiring (SosRelay gate) and lichen-apps/rust parity.
close_reason: Implemented per the bead's proposal; wire-format spec note for 18.4.3 may be needed. ENFORCEMENT (landed on main in 92469a5d16 + 4ea1b8f9d6, verified this session): SosResource.render_post enforces spec 18.4.1 origin signatures with zero state on rejection — gate order: field validation (4.00) -> envelope present/parse (4.01) -> pubkey-to-IID derivation binding (4.01) -> verify_sos_origin over canonical CBOR (4.01) -> optional TrustStore TOFU pin (4.01) -> monotonic sequence gate (4.01) -> rate limit (4.29 + retry_after) -> 2.01 activate. Missing/invalid signature: no activation, no rate-limit record, no sequence accept. DELETE /sos enforces the same signed-cancel gate. WIRE FORMAT (landed, differs from bead proposal in 2 details): body = core alert dict + envelope {"pubkey": 32B bstr, "sig": 56B bstr}; sig = >Q big-endian seq || 48B Schnorr48 (SosOriginSignature.to_bytes); signed payload = canonical CBOR (RFC 8949 4.2.1) of body minus {pubkey, sig}. Deviation 1: envelope field named 'sig' not 'origin_sig' — matches sibling bead fi68's landed-design note. Deviation 2: origin address = 0200:0000:0000:0000:<IID> reconstructed from the claimed node/from field and bound to pubkey via _pubkey_to_iid, NOT fe80::IID(pub) — the bead's fe80 form contradicts the external oracle test/vectors/sos_signature.json 'origin_transcript_format', which pins origin_address 0200:1234:... (0200::/8), and the verifier's own docstring ('originator's 02xx IPv6 address'). Per bead instructions the proposal sub-part was not invented differently; the landed format is the one consistent with verifier + vectors. TESTS: 201 passed in test_sos_resource.py + test_security_app_vector_consumers.py (all ~10 former unsigned-POST tests already switched to signed bodies using derive_keypair + _pubkey_to_iid real identities); xfail(strict) pin test_unsigned_sos_must_be_silently_dropped already flipped to a strict direct assertion (unsuccessful response, not activated, no rate-limit burn). Full suite: 1788 passed, 1 skipped (unrelated CBOR-marker vector), 3 xfailed (pinned wrong-CBOR-order vectors). RELAY PATH: SosRelay.check_relay gates dedup + monotonic OriginSequenceTracker; signature verification precedes rebroadcast by design (verify at each receiving node) and SosRelay is a library component with no production forwarding caller in python/src — nothing further to wire. RUST PARITY: rust/lichen-link/src/sos_origin.rs already has verify_sos_origin + 56B SosOriginSignature with vector tests; no Rust CoAP POST /sos resource exists yet, so there is no Rust enforcement gap to fix — the existing OPEN bead project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.10.17.2 (Rust: Emergency / SOS implementation) covers the future Rust SOS path and must wire this same gate; no duplicate bead filed. SPEC NOTE FLAG: spec/12-apps.md 18.4.2/18.4.3 CBOR examples show no signature envelope fields; a doc update should document the {pubkey, sig} envelope for the CoAP POST path (out of scope here). DUP BEAD NOTE: project-LICHEN-worker6-fi68 is a sibling/duplicate of this gap-1 bead (its notes describe the same landed design) — suggest superseding one of the two.
